name: Holder XP
summary: An on-chain loyalty ledger earned through routed buys and holding, with anti-wash rules.
behavior: XP is earned on routed buys only, never on sells.
Buy XP vests after a hold period; selling before vesting forfeits the unvested XP, so buy/sell loops earn nothing.
Per-trade cap, minimum trade size and a daily cap per wallet.
Optional holding XP on min(balance at last checkpoint, balance now) × elapsed time.
verification: source in this repository; reproducible-build verification not yet published
limitations: XP is a ledger entry, not a token and not a claim on fees.
Two wallets that each hold at both of their own checkpoints can overlap holding intervals; caps bound the effect (threat model T20).
